resolution_notes: docs_url: Replace the original. The official TAP user guide documents the /TAP service, supported tables, ADQL queries, formats, and base URLs, and was updated July 24, 2026: https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/TAP/usingTAP.html. The original URL is the legacy API guide and explicitly directs programmatic users to TAP.
